parameters.content:
## Upwork Leads

- Runs every 6 hours
- runs Apify Upwork Extractor Actor to get latest 50 job postings by search term
- adds to memory (prevents dupes across runs)
- formats digest email of all job leads
- posts each new job to the Prospects API (adamhaley.com)

parameters.query:
-- Each run: insert all scraped IDs, skip existing ones, return only new ones
-- jobIds must be JSON-stringified here; n8n 2.29.8 flattened raw array params
  INSERT INTO seen_upwork_jobs (job_id)
  SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (job_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING job_id;
